LanguageData.DeltaV_PilotGravityRestricted: In gravity, a grav engine and thrusters can only make short, targeted ballistic hops. Free non-targeted flight is available only in zero gravity.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsFlightAssistTip: While piloting, axes without player input are counter-thrusted using the ship's real thruster power (no artificial damping).
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsCellsPerTile: Sector scale: cells per world tile (100-100000)
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsCellsPerTileNote: Sets how many universe cells one sector (world tile) spans. Changing it takes effect immediately: all object poses rescale around their sector centers (velocities untouched); cannot be changed while docking or launching is in progress. Does not affect tile partitioning or tactical judgments.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ScaleChangeBlocked: Sector scale cannot be changed while docking or launching is in progress.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsLogNote: Module-gated verbose logs ([DeltaV:Module] prefix). Warnings/errors and key state transitions (pilot enter/exit, suppression activation, patch init) are always logged regardless.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SaveBlockedGenerating: Delta-V is incrementally generating a map ({0}). Please save again after it finishes.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ApproachAborted: Docking failed unexpectedly. The ship remains in free flight and docking can be retried.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockFailHostMap: No landing map could be resolved for the current position.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockFailNoTarget: No loaded object interior is under the ship to dock onto. Approach a station, wreck or another ship and try again; powered ships in motion can also be docked (the autopilot matches their velocity).
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockFailBusy: Another gravship landing or flight operation is already in progress.
LanguageData.DeltaV_LaunchFailNoThruster: No operational thruster found; the ship cannot separate under thrust and begin free flight.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ConsoleGizmoPrimaryTip: The ship's heading when beginning free flight follows the primary console's facing.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ConsolePrimary: This is the primary pilot console.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PanelPickConsoleTip: Several ships are docked here. Select the target ship's pilot console and enter pilot mode from its gizmo.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PanelObjectNotLoaded: Not in visual range yet: approach the object first (unloaded objects cannot be focused).
LanguageData.DeltaV_SubstructureOwnerConflict: Cannot build substructure here: it would touch substructure belonging to multiple different structures.
LanguageData.DeltaV_LandingBlockedForeignSubstructure: Cannot land here: the footprint would touch substructure belonging to another object. Leave a gap and connect via docking ports.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ReassignSubstructureDesc: Change which structure owns substructure cells. Ownership decides what a grav engine counts, what launches take along, and each ship's silhouette. First pick the target owner, then drag over substructure cells.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ReassignNoTarget: No reassignable substructure on this map.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ReassignSelected: Target owner set: {0}. Now drag over substructure cells.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockExtendDesc: Extend a sealed docking channel in this port's facing direction, up to the first structure. Fails if nothing stands within range.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockRetractDesc: Fold the docking channel away and restore open space.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockNoFace: No structure within docking range in this port's facing direction.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SectorMapAbandonConfirm: Launching will abandon the map of the current sector, "{0}", by the vanilla unanchored-takeoff rule - the map and everything not leaving with the ship will be permanently lost (build a grav anchor on that map to keep it). Proceed?
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockPlanStarted: Docking plan engaged: {0} -> {1}. The autopilot is closing in; you may also fly to the marked position (semi-transparent ghost) manually - holding the pose there long enough completes the docking.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockPlanCancelled: Docking plan cancelled; the ship continues in free flight.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockPlanBlocksDesignator: Docking in progress: structural and planning changes are locked. Cancel the docking first.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockPlanBlocksLaunch: Docking in progress: gravship launch is locked. Cancel the docking first.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PilotWrongFaction: Only player-owned ships can be piloted.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PodLaunchDesc: Load the currently selected colonists into a boarding pod and fire it: the pod homes in on the target ship like a missile, punches through the outer shell, seals the breach with its own hull and deploys the crew inside. One-way insertion.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PodNeedCrew: Select the colonists to deploy (on this ship) first.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PodNoTarget: You must aim at another loaded ship's hull.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PodImpact: Boarding pod hit {0}: the breach is plugged by the sealed pod hull and the crew is inside.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PodLost: Boarding pod lost (timeout or target destroyed); crew missing.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ConsoleGizmoBackupTip: Release the claim on this structure. The structure becomes a wreck until another console claims it (docked ships: separate via thruster fire first).
LanguageData.DeltaV_PanelShipRowTip: Select '{0}' as the ship to view and operate.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PanelHeadingTip: Click a compass direction to rotate the whole ship map to that on-screen facing (buildings rotate into a new pocket map coinciding with the current position). The ship's orbital heading, position and velocity are preserved; free flight only, unavailable during a docking plan.
LanguageData.DeltaV_RotateBlockedPlan: Cannot rotate the ship while a docking plan is active.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SeparationCancelled: Separation cancelled and pilot mode exited. Re-enter pilot mode and thrust to try again.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockSourceLeftoverChanged: Left-behind contents changed during approach; docking aborted. Restart docking to confirm the new list.
LanguageData.DeltaV_UndockFragmentsLine: - {0} disconnected fragment(s) of this ship will be left behind as wrecks
LanguageData.DeltaV_LeftBehindLine: - Pawn/item list left behind on this map: {0}
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsPassiveDrag: Passive drag (Newton spins in his coffin)
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsPassiveDragTip: Damps linear and angular velocity with a half-life, coexisting with flight assist. Not a thruster command: no fuel, no flames, no hull splitting. Uses the same model in the autopilot's prediction.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ReassignProtectedMainConsole: Main console foundations cannot be reassigned ({0} cell(s) skipped). Set the console to backup or deconstruct it first.
